Asha (AE): Quick kickover for IONOS Health — closing tomorrow at 10am PT. TL;DR: Dedicated+Private, SSO via SAML, VPC peering needed, initial traffic low but ramp planned end of month. Renewal window Q3. Need CS owner for enablement + CS->eng escalation path.

Priya (CSM): I can own onboarding. Need AWS account ID, SSO metadata, and a list of must-have prompts/evals. Can someone drop creds or point to the ticket?

Miguel (SE): We've provisioned a staging fleet (dedicated-north-1) and uploaded model artifacts. Still need VPC peering config from customer and route table entries. @Lee (Support) can you open infra ticket for subnet pairing?

Lee (Support): creating internal ticket now: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/4127|ticket-4127>. Adding tags: ionos-health, private-deploy, sso. Assigning to Miguel for infra follow-up. ETA initial triage 4h. :gear:

Asha (AE): Customer contact is sam@ionos-health.com, AWS acct 987654321000. Sam expects 1:1 enablement next Tue. They flagged data residency as a potential renewal risk if not completed in 2 weeks.

Priya (CSM): Booking enablement: proposed Wed 9am PT. I'll send calendar invite once infra ticket confirmed. Owners so far: Priya — onboarding/enablement; Miguel — infra/dedicated; Lee — support ticket/triage; Asha — sales escalation. Any objections?

Miguel (SE): SGs and route table snippet I'll add to ticket. Quick snippet for their side:

```
# Customer: add route to peering
Destination: 10.40.0.0/16
Target: pcx-0a1b2c3d4e
```

Priya (CSM): Thanks — capturing action items in internal onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/ionos-health. I'll collect feedback forms post-session and flag any quality regressions to Research.

Lee (Support): Ticket 4127 created and linked to onboarding doc. I'll update channel when peering is complete. :white_check_mark:

Asha (AE): thx team. One more: Sam asked about cost-optimization options (batching + KV cache). Priya — pls highlight Redwood Optimize recommendations during enablement.

Priya (CSM): Will do. Also adding renewal watch tag to account in CRM. Follow-ups: Priya to send invite, Miguel to post peering update in ticket, Lee to close ticket after validation. Last message — ping if anything blocks.
